correctness.rationale: The construction is internally correct. The three-skip lemma follows because, for k<i and d>x_k, six of the nine possible equalities between J_i(d) and J_k force d-x_k<0; the only surviving equality types are d+i=x_k+2k, d+i=x_k+k+2h, and d+2i=x_k+k+2h. Across the globally increasing greedy search each corresponding new coordinate is strictly increasing, so a fixed earlier J_k can cause at most three rejected d-values in total. Hence x_{h-1}<=6h-7 and L=2x_{h-1}+2h+1<=14h-13. The four block-length ranges are disjoint, the cyclic placement preserves the unit-offset joint pattern, the filler steps cannot collide because every filler exceeds h while the endpoint window has width h-2, and the final (i,2h-i)->2h replacement only deletes a joint. An independent reimplementation verified the completed permutations and global proper-prefix disjointness for h=2,...,60 and h=75,100,150,200.

originality.rationale: Qualified chronological originality passes. The direct parent preprint, posted 2026-09-16, publicly claims only existence of linear-height Barrycades; the audited record was published 2026-09-17 and its documented source inspection identifies a 24h-scale explicit construction there. Targeted searches did not locate the 14h-13 or 1/14 sharpening in material predating the record. A much stronger preprint, How to Construct High Barrycades (arXiv:2609.24373), was posted on 2026-09-21 and gives order 2h+3 for height h; because it postdates the record it does not negate chronological originality, but it is an important present-day qualification. The inaccessible/unpublished Building barricades manuscript remains an unresolved priority risk and is not represented as read.

scientific_value.rationale: At its publication date the theorem was a genuine infinite-family quantitative sharpening of the then-documented explicit linear construction, improving the guaranteed asymptotic height/order coefficient from 1/24 to 1/14 by a concise collision-counting idea rather than by a finite computation. The result is now quantitatively superseded by the 2026-09-21 2h+3 construction, so its present value is mainly as an independent intermediate construction and a clean three-forward-collision argument; that later domination is a limitation, not a correctness defect or retroactive loss of priority.

independent_checks: Re-derived all nine joint-collision equations and verified only three can satisfy d>x_k for k<i.
Proved the auxiliary block-length families occupy disjoint ranges and that h and 2h are absent before the final replacement.
Independently reimplemented the full construction and verified 63 parameter values, including h=200.
limitations: The unpublished manuscript Building barricades and the partially accessible 2025 Barrycades chapter were not read and remain originality risks.
The stronger arXiv:2609.24373 appeared four days after this record and supersedes its quantitative bound for current applications.
No inaccessible source is represented as read.
